topic.source_contract: project boundary, planning route, land quality, layout, grid connection, construction, operation and decommissioning evidence

scope_guards: A solar opportunity map is not treated as a consented project.
A grid connection application is not treated as a secured connection.
A planning application is not treated as planning permission.
Planning permission is not treated as completed construction.
Installed panels are not treated as commissioned generation.
A biodiversity or landscape plan is not treated as implemented mitigation.
A decommissioning condition is not treated as completed site restoration.
No score or promotion is written without exact land, consent, connection, construction, commissioning and decommissioning evidence.

ALC and prior land use required
Panel, inverter, substation and access layout required
Zone of theoretical visibility and mitigation required
Baseline, BNG and protected-species controls required

Assets, archaeology and setting assessment required
HGV route and compound evidence required
Bond, plan, trigger and restoration required
